name: Cloud project
description: Project hosted by a cloud provider.

name.label: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the cloud project.
name.help: Use the name by which the project is commonly identified.

cloud_provider_id.label: Cloud provider
cloud_provider_id.help: Select the provider that owns and operates this cloud project.

extref_project_id.label: External project ID
extref_project_id.description: Project identifier assigned by the cloud provider.
extref_project_id.help: Enter the provider's project identifier, such as an OVHcloud or Google Cloud project ID.

cloud_provider_code.label: Cloud provider code
cloud_provider_code.description: Technical code of the cloud provider hosting the project.
cloud_provider_code.help: This value is derived from the selected cloud provider.

servers_ids.label: Servers
servers_ids.description: Servers hosted in the cloud project.
servers_ids.help: Lists the servers associated with this cloud project.

provider_catalog.label: Provider catalog
provider_catalog.description: Provider-specific resources available to this cloud project.
provider_catalog.help: Synchronize the catalog to refresh regional flavors, images, SSH keys and networks.

api_credentials.label: API credentials
api_credentials.description: Credentials used to authenticate requests to the cloud provider API.
api_credentials.help: Enter a valid JSON object. For OVHcloud, provide application_key, application_secret and consumer_key. Keep these credentials secret and grant only the required permissions.

form.default.name: Cloud project
form.default.description: Displays and edits a cloud project.

action.create-server.label: Create OVHcloud server
action.create-server.description: Creates a server in this OVHcloud project.

action.sync-ovh-provider-catalog.label: Synchronize OVH catalog
action.sync-ovh-provider-catalog.description: Refreshes the regional resources available to this cloud project.
